scope: Source-isolated ATP/WTA main-tour development; no live pricing integration
availability: tournament_start +21d strictly before forecast date; also before fit cutoff for training labels; synthetic dev only
confirmation: 2025H2 already seen; do not open on failed development
historical_control: 1500 initial Elo, K=120/(n+5)^0.4; pre-update overall/surface frozen together; .65 surface/.35 overall; not B_live; current nudges unavailable so no live accuracy claim
surface_candidate: player-specific surface weight n_surface/(n_surface+20), everything else identical; no fitting
rank: most recent positive rank in released historical row, not target row rank; log(rank_B)-log(rank_A); either absent ->0 plus signed missing flag
opponents: last10 released matches; opponent overall Elo and own overall Elo captured before that historical match; low<1400/high>1600 fractions; added strength=(mean opponent minus own contemporaneous Elo)/400, A minus B
serve: last25 released canonical matches, including missing-stat matches in the 25; 8 factorial profiles 000/R/E/S/RE/RS/ES/RES; two logit-difference columns for service/return point-win rates
R: 2^(-age_days/180), age from tournament start; no search
E: E-on point weight=R or1; E-off point weight=(R or1)*reference_exposure/n_points, yielding equal-match unshrunk means; denominators then explicitly point-equivalent, not actual counted exposure
S: add100 pseudo-points once to weighted profile denominator, numerator+100*tour prior; prior and reference_exposure fixed from2020 rows available before2021-01-01; reference=median service points per player-match; fallback same prior for all arms; rates logit-clipped1e-6 only for numeric finiteness
h2h: Elo-only and Elo+raw centered H2H controls; candidate Elo+sum(y_i-p_i)/(n+5); p_i frozen historical pre-match .65/.35 Elo; same pair all surfaces; absent->0
fitting: sum weighted NLL +0.5*beta^2, no intercept; divide by training-population std without mean centering; zero std->1; Newton100 iterations/max step<1e-10; fitting failure is FIT_ERROR, never a favorable performance result
orientation: tour + ascending source player IDs; all feature columns signed under swap; one match weight1; no extra mirrored observations in evaluation

statistics.p_value: two-sided centered paired bootstrap tail, plus-one correction; missing/unrun p=1

decision: All5 folds LL and Brier nonworsening vs direct control; pooled both gains>0 and all required Holm-adjusted p<=.05. Every F05 candidate must beat both000 and simple; RES must additionally beat each leave-one-out before keeping complexity. Holm-only failures remain pending until reserved slots are finalized; fold regression is REJECT_DEV. All historical advances remain NEEDS_MORE_TESTING, not promotion.

unavailable.B_live: No qualified full live feature projections; unavailable on source-isolated historical cohort
unavailable.B_market: Fixed5-fold 2023H1-2025H1 price corpus incomplete; do not replace folds
unavailable.workload: Tournament-start-only dates with21d lag cannot establish actual14d workload or end-time hours
unavailable.joint_props: Independent market/settlement and historical rules contracts still incomplete

deferred: F09 and combo use reserved comparison slots. Freeze their exact input recipes before fitting; never reset Holm family or choose a failed single arm to rescue RES; adaptive historical choices are dev only, not independent confirmation.
stop: Missing raw IDs/identity, row-flow mismatch, temporal leakage, nonfinite features/losses, failed synthetic causal/swap tests, mismatched cohort or changed protocol/method hashes -> no candidate run
